integration_highlights.mailchimp: Industry-leading email marketing platform - newsletter campaigns, audience segmentation, and marketing automation with millions of users worldwide
integration_highlights.activecampaign: Advanced marketing automation and CRM - lead scoring, sales pipelines, and sophisticated multi-step automation workflows for complete customer lifecycle
integration_highlights.calendly: Meeting scheduling automation - eliminates back-and-forth emails with intelligent booking, team round-robin, and multi-timezone support
integration_highlights.docusign: Electronic signature platform - contract automation, compliance tracking, and legally binding e-signatures trusted by 1M+ organizations

marketing_campaign_automation.description: End-to-end marketing campaign with Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, and HubSpot
flow: ActiveCampaign: Import leads from website form submissions
ActiveCampaign: Score leads based on engagement and behavior
ActiveCampaign: Segment hot leads (score > 75) for immediate outreach
Mailchimp: Add cold/warm leads to nurture campaign list
Mailchimp: Send automated 5-email nurture sequence over 2 weeks
ActiveCampaign: Trigger sales automation for engaged email recipients
HubSpot: Create deals for qualified leads in CRM pipeline
Slack: Notify sales team of hot leads ready for outreach
Mailchimp: Track campaign performance and A/B test subject lines
ActiveCampaign: Move converted leads to customer automation workflow

sales_demo_scheduling.description: Automated sales demo booking with Calendly, ActiveCampaign, and Slack
flow: Calendly: Lead books demo via website Calendly widget
Calendly: Webhook triggers on new scheduled event
ActiveCampaign: Create or update contact with demo details
ActiveCampaign: Tag contact as 'Demo Scheduled' and add to pipeline
Slack: Notify assigned sales rep with lead context and meeting details
Twilio: Send SMS reminder to lead 24 hours before demo
Calendly: Track invitee attendance (show/no-show)
ActiveCampaign: Update deal stage based on demo outcome
Calendly: Auto-reschedule if no-show with follow-up automation
ActiveCampaign: Trigger post-demo follow-up email sequence

contract_signing_workflow.description: Automated contract generation and signing with DocuSign, Notion, and Salesforce
flow: Salesforce: Deal reaches 'Verbal Agreement' stage
Notion: Retrieve contract template from contracts database
Salesforce: Pull deal details (customer name, pricing, terms)
DocuSign: Generate envelope from template with deal data
DocuSign: Add customer as signer, sales rep as carbon copy
DocuSign: Send envelope via email with 7-day expiration
Slack: Notify legal team that contract sent for review
DocuSign: Track signature status and reminder emails
Salesforce: Update deal stage to 'Contract Signed' on completion
DocuSign: Download signed contract and audit trail
Notion: Store completed contract in contracts database
Slack: Celebrate deal closure with team announcement

email_list_building_campaign.description: Lead magnet campaign with Mailchimp, Notion, and Google Drive
flow: Notion: Create content calendar entry for lead magnet campaign
Google Drive: Upload lead magnet PDF (e.g., industry report, checklist)
Mailchimp: Create new audience segment for lead magnet subscribers
Mailchimp: Design landing page form with email capture
Mailchimp: Set up automation to send lead magnet immediately
Mailchimp: Create 3-email welcome series for new subscribers
Notion: Track campaign metrics (conversions, open rates, CTR)
Mailchimp: A/B test subject lines and send times for optimization
Slack: Daily digest of new subscribers and engagement metrics
Mailchimp: Tag engaged subscribers for sales team outreach
